identity.name: The Diplomat
identity.description: An English-language magazine focused on politics, security, economics and society across the Indo-Pacific, with a strong Asia-Pacific analysis franchise.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Acquired by Japan's MHT Corporation in 2007; operated through Trans-Asia Inc. in Japan and Diplomat Media Inc. in the United States. James Pach is identified with day-to-day leadership.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Regional specialist publication with bylined analysis and a range of Asia-Pacific viewpoints; no evidence of single-state editorial direction.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Least Biased; coverage is analytical and regionally plural rather than partisan.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic analysis spans market, state-capitalist and development perspectives without a consistent ideological programme.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames regional security through alliance politics, territorial disputes and Indo-Pacific institution-building, with substantial attention to non-US actors.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; established Asia-Pacific specialist with named contributors.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Least Biased; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Asia-Pacific specialist analysis. Explains regional developments through sovereignty, alliance politics, trade and domestic political economy, with more depth on smaller Asian states than global wires usually provide.

selectionRationale: Fills the Indo-Pacific analysis gap between global wires and single-country national outlets.

research.researchNotes: Ownership verified through official page and corporate references. Existing production mapping retained. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
